outcome: maternal outcomes (pneumonitis, fever, cough, lymphopenia, maternal death due to multi-organ failure)
neonatal outcomes (SARS-CoV-2 positivity, respiratory distress, neonatal death)
cohort: Seven pregnant women with severe SARS-CoV-2 infection, all presenting in the third trimester.
finding: Management of severe COVID-19 in pregnancy aligns with general population protocols, and vertical transmission appears rare with minimal neonatal impact.
